purpose.domain_detail: Report generation or batch data processing with record formatting and logging; program name prefix 'CAS' may indicate a case/claims processing system
purpose.summary: MAIN is a batch driver program that initializes by reading and formatting header records, then loops reading and formatting detail records (up to 40 per page before printing footer/header), and finally performs termination processing. It delegates all I/O and formatting to subprograms (GETREC, RPTREC, FMTREC4, LOGGER).

notable_features: High CALL count (30) with no COPY statements
RETURN-CODE used as loop termination condition
Page-break logic with 40-record counter triggering GET-FOOTER/GET-HEADER
verdict.notes: Dialect is medium-confidence GnuCOBOL due to z'' literal syntax; could also be Micro Focus which supports similar syntax. The file has no COPY statements and minimal data definitions, suggesting most logic is in called subprograms. Indentation is slightly inconsistent (some paragraphs at column 8, some at column 9) but all lines fit within 72 columns confirming fixed format.
